Three years after the death of Paul Cattermole, S Club is reuniting once again for a tour across the U.K. and Ireland.
On Thursday, the remaining lineup of the 90s British pop group announced the dates of their 12-city Ain’t No Party Like an S Club Party Tour, which kicks off Oct. 8, 2027 at Glasgow’s OVO Hydro arena.
“There really Ain’t No Party Like An S Club Party, and we’re so excited to be back for a new tour across the UK & Ireland in October 2027!” the group posted on Instagram . “We can’t wait to celebrate the songs, memories and moments we’ve shared together. It’s going to be one big party and we want you all to be part of it. From the sing-a-longs to seeing you nail the dance routines, and we’re so glad our friends @officialboyzlife are joining us to kick it all off!”

S Club 7 Member Paul Cattermole, 46, Dies Months After Band Announced Upcoming Reunion Tour
Following The Good Times Tour from 2023 to ’24, which was announced months before Cattermole’s death at age 46 , the tour marks the reunion of Bradley McIntosh, Rachel Stevens, Jon Lee, Tina Barrett and Jo O’Meara. Watch on Deadline
Cattermole died on April 6, 2023 at his Dorset home from cardiac arrhythmia, acute myocardial ischemia and severe coronary artery atheroma and intraplaque haemorrhage.
Hannah Spearritt, who was previously in a relationship with Cattermole, declined to reunite with the group at the time, sitting out this tour as well.
Created by Spice Girls manager Simon Fuller in 1998, S Club 7 released three albums from 1999 to 2001, in addition to starring as themselves in the CBBC/Fox Family series Miami 7 ( S Club 7 in Miami ), which led to several specials and the spin-off LA 7 ( S Club 7 in LA ).
